methodology.completeness: section-complete for the recorded storefront claims; not a nationwide inventory
methodology.chainCoreRule: Present in at least 3 of 5 sampled branches (>=60%).
methodology.normalization: NFC, Turkish-aware case folding, punctuation folding, stable branch/category/name sorting.
methodology.pricePolicy: Lowest listed base variation price per branch; promotion bundles are excluded.
methodology.unknownFieldPolicy: Nutrition and allergens remain unknown; no values are inferred.
exclusionRules: beans, ground coffee, instant coffee, and capsules
generic or unrelated bottled retail drinks

officialSources.role: Official chain identity and current brand site.
Official store directory used to reconcile the sampled chain and cities.

sourceAttribution.productSurface: Named chain storefronts on Yemeksepeti backed by Delivery Hero public vendor menus.
sourceAttribution.sourceTierRationale: The storefronts identify the named chain and expose branch address/legal merchant context, but are hosted by a third-party ordering platform.
